generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original independent logo concept for dealer preview, transparent PNG master
Primary request: design a striking contemporary specialist used-car retailer identity with exact brand text "C-Car Sales Ltd" and no other words.
Identity idea: a custom negative-space double-C ligature inside a compact near-square geometric motif, refined and instantly readable. To the right, clear type "C-Car Sales Ltd" with very balanced proportions and high legibility.
Style: exceptionally polished Swiss editorial identity, clean flat vector-like edges, thoughtful optical kerning, mature rather than flashy.
Palette: nearly black charcoal with restrained burnt-copper/orange accent, no gradients.
Composition: wide horizontal wordmark plus separable compact emblem, all centered with generous genuine transparent padding.
Constraints: spell "C-Car Sales Ltd" exactly with the hyphen, never "C&Car" or a different name; no watermark, no white/colored box background, no faux transparency grid, no vehicle silhouette, no wing logo, no badge clutter, no 3D mockup. Independent proposal, not dealer approved.

holdReasons: Concept not compared with recognizable same-business published logo
No separate 32/48/64px compact mark and on-dark/accent exports
No maintained source-pack hashes or six-template screenshot review
